cohort: 861 women with recurrent GDM who had two consecutive singleton deliveries
finding: Recurrent gestational diabetes is associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery, incidence of LGA, and neonatal admission to the NICU in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly higher in subsequent pregnancies compared to index pregnancies (32.9% vs 6.6%, p = .039).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight in index pregnancies: 3296.63 ± 16.85 g; mean birth weight in subsequent pregnancies: 3348.99 ± 16.05 g
